passage:
Hi Julianne,

We wanted to take a moment to thank you for being such a loyal patient over the last five years. We always enjoy seeing you in the clinic, and we truly appreciate the trust you place in our team to take care of your oral health.

We've noticed that many of our best new patients come to us through word-of-mouth recommendations from people like you. Because of this, we are officially launching our "Healthy Smiles Referral Program," and we'd love for you to be a part of it!

How it works:

The next time you're chatting with a friend, family member, or colleague who is looking for a new dentist, simply give them one of our "Referral Cards" (available at the front desk) or have them mention your name when they book their first appointment.

As a token of our appreciation, for every person you refer who completes a new patient exam and cleaning:

1. You receive: A $50 credit toward any future treatment or professional whitening service.

2. They receive: A "Welcome Package" that includes a high-end electric toothbrush and a complimentary panoramic X-ray (a $150 value).

There's no limit to how many credits you can earn! If you refer four friends, your next major cleaning or filling could be entirely covered. We believe that a referral is the highest compliment we can receive, and we want to make sure you feel rewarded for sharing your positive experience.

On your next visit, keep an eye out for our new "Patient Appreciation Wall" in the lobby—we'll be featuring some of our top referrers and sharing some fun dental health tips. Speaking of your next visit, you're currently scheduled for your six-month check-up on Tuesday, November 12, at 10:30 AM. If you need to reschedule, please let us know at least 24 hours in advance.

Keep smiling!

Best,
Dr. Aris and the Team at Bright Smile Dental
